pr_title: Rework velbus services to deprecated the interface parameter
pr_body:
## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->

Currently the velbus services use a interface parameter, this is a simple string that should be exactly the same as the config_entry parameter.

With this PR i'm deprecating this interface parameter and adding a new parameter that uses a config_entry selector, this is more user-friendly.

The interface parameter is deprecated and will be remover in the 2025.9 release.

issue_context.title: [Velbus] Set_memo_text not working in HA 2025.1
issue_context.body:
### The problem

set_memo_text does not display any text anymore on module VMBELO since HA2025.1

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2025.1.0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

2024.12.5

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Velbus

### Link to integration documentation on our website

_No response_

### Diagnostics information

no text displayed on module, no errors in log file.
All other Velbus items/actions are OK (controlling relays, lights, sensors)


### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
action: velbus.set_memo_text
data:
  interface: 192.168.2.17:3788
  memo_text: test text
  address: 115
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
2025-01-06 08:40:16.056 INFO (MainThread) [homeassistant.helpers.script.websocket_api_script] websocket_api script: Running websocket_api script
2025-01-06 08:40:16.056 INFO (MainThread) [homeassistant.helpers.script.websocket_api_script] websocket_api script: Executing step call service
```


### Additional information

_No response_
